title: Characterizing Timing Parameters in Commercial SERF-OPM Multichannel Systems for Biomagnetic Field Sensing
summary: Head-to-head characterization of four commercial SERF-OPM systems (QuSpin Neuro-1, FieldLine HEDscan, FieldLine FLv2, QuSpin QZFM Gen.2). All achieve intrinsic noise well below 50 fT/sqrt(Hz). Key specs: Neuro-1 triaxial 19/21 heads; HEDscan dual-axis 18/24 heads; FLv2 single-axis 17/17 heads; QZFM Gen.2 dual-axis 13/16 heads. Time delay at 28 Hz: Neuro-1 8.7-9.3 ms, HEDscan 1.8-1.9 ms, FLv2 1.2 ms. Bandwidth: Neuro-1 ~150 Hz, HEDscan ~250 Hz, FLv2 ~360 Hz. Authors note simulation studies still required before clinical deployment.
bci_relevance: Definitive benchmark for commercial wearable OPM-MEG. Shows timing inter-channel spread is <0.3 ms — adequate for BCI decoding. Not yet clinical-grade.
independent_researcher_budget: QuSpin QZFM Gen.2 sensors ~$7,700 each in quantity 32 (~$247k for 32-ch array). Single-channel bench setup much cheaper.
